description: Search UAE property listings for sale or rent by area, price, bedrooms, and type. Takes a place name, not an ID. Prices are AED; for rentals the price is the ANNUAL rent. Returns asking prices from current listings, which run higher than actual sale prices, so use get_transactions for what property really sold for.

bedrooms.description: "0" is a studio, "1", "2", and so on

location.description: Area name, for example "dubai marina", "jvc", "business bay"

name: search_properties
title: Search property listings
